title: NEW EVENT: RECLAMATION ALGORITHM [TALES WITHIN THE SAND]
lines: 01 RECLAMATION ALGORITHM [TALES WITHIN THE SAND] OPEN

DETAILS: Reclamation Algorithm [Tales Within the Sand] will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Prosperity Points through the event. Prosperity Points can be used to redeem [Expansional Rewards].
[EXPANSIONAL REWARDS]: [★★★★★: Kestrel], Kestrel's Token, Icon 'Dawn on the Dunes', Arsalan Travel Tent Furniture, Elite Materials, LMD, etc.

- During [Tales Within the Sand], there will be monthly updates for [Expansional Rewards], Prosperity Points and other content starting from the second month onwards. Please stay tuned for more details.
02 UNVEILING OF DEVOTION SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Unveiling of Devotion - Decoration for Harmonie
Unveiling of Devotion - Dangerous Invitation for Arene
CONTENTS: Orundum * 4500, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1

Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired 5-star Operator to Elite 2, Level 1 (effective for Operators under Elite 2, Level 1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
Please stay tuned for more information!
